newsitem.title: USA: Soros group holds 5.2 pct WMX Tech stake.
newsitem.headline: Soros group holds 5.2 pct WMX Tech stake.

text.p: A group led by international financier George Soros said Wednesday in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing it holds a 5.2 percent stake or 25.225 million common shares in WMX Technologies Inc.

The group said its holdings have not changed since it initially disclosed the stake on May 23, but the percentage has gone up from the previous 5.09 percent because of a recent decrease in the total common stock outstanding of WMX.
According to the filing, Soros and companies that he controls, including Quantum Partners, hold 22.6 million shares of WMX, an international environmental services company based in Oak Brook, Ill.

In addition, Duquesne Capital Management LLC, an investment firm advised by Stanley Druckenmiller, one of Soros' chief lieutenants, holds 2.625 million common shares. Druckenmiller is a director of Soros Fund Management, which advises Quantum Partners and other funds.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes.
